In 2014, the IPCC Fifth Synthesis Report warned that crossing the 1.5 degree Celsius threshold
could result in more severe and devastating climate change impacts.

transcript_full: Why do we all need to act urgently to tackle climate change? In 2014, the IPCC Fifth Synthesis Report warned that crossing the 1.5 degree Celsius threshold could result in more severe and devastating climate change impacts. To limit global warming, emissions must peak before 2025 and decline by 43% by 2013. As a result, in 2015, the Paris Agreement and International Treaty was adopted by 196 parties at the COP 21 in Paris. Finally, the most important decision was made at COP 28 in UAE to transition away from fossil fuels. And how can this be possible if we do not change our habits and reduce our dependence on fossil fuels? Stay tuned for easy solutions.
